name: ISO 14229-1 identification DIDs
author: OpenTune contributors
description: The standardised UDS identification data identifiers 0xF180-0xF19F (ISO 14229-1 Annex C) as a logger definition, plus read-only service scripts for the most common ones. DID numbers and names are the standard's; the name list was cross-checked against opendbc's opendbc/car/uds.py (MIT). Contents/encoding of each DID are manufacturer-defined.
